arabic text: YA FATIMA RIDA MEIN CHUPA LO HUSSAIN KO.\nMAQTAL MEIN GIR RAHA HAI SANBHALO\nHUSSAIN(AS) KO.
english translation text: O Fatima, conceal Hussain within\nyour veil. He is\nfalling in the battlefield—hold Hussain.

arabic text:
PAIWAST HAI GHAREEB KE PEHLU MEIN
BARCHIYAAN.
TUM KO BHI UTHNE DETI NAHI TOOTI
PASLIYAAN.
LE KAR ALI(AS) KA NAAM UTHA LO
HUSSAIN(AS) KO.
english translation text:
Spears are embedded in
the lonely one's side.
Your broken ribs do
not even allow you
to rise. Take Ali's
name and lift Hussain.

arabic text:
DEWAR-O-DAR KE BEECH JO ARMAN REH GAYE.
RAKHI HOI THI DILL MEIN JO MOHSIN(AS) KE
WASTAY.
WOH LORIYAAN BHI AAJ SUNA LO HUSSAIN(AS)
KO.
english translation text:
The longings that remained between
the wall and door, which
you had preserved within your
heart for Mohsin— sing
those lullabies today to Hussain.

arabic text:
SOLAH PEHAR KI PIYAS HAI OUR HAI LABOON
PE DAM.
DE KAR GHAREEB BETE KO ABBAS(AS) KI
QASAM.
PANI AGAR MILE TU PILA LO HUSSAIN(AS) KO.
english translation text:
He has endured sixteen watches of
thirst, and his life is upon
his lips. By Abbas's oath, give
water to your exiled son should
any water be found—give it to Hussain.

arabic text: SHEH KI GHAREEB BETI KE ARMAN KI TARHA.\nGODI MEIN LE KE TEESRI SHABAN KI TARHA.
english translation text: Like the longing of the King's exiled daughter,\ntake him into your lap as on the third of Sha'ban.

arabic text: KUCH DAIR HO SAKE TU SULA LO HUSSAIN(AS)\nKO.
english translation text: If only for a short while,\nput Hussain to sleep.

arabic text:
HAIDER(AS) TARAP RAHE HAIN
PAYAMBER(SAWW) HAIN BE-QARAR.
TUM KAISE SUN RAHI HO SADAEIN YEH BAR
BAR.
IK SHOOR HAI ZAMEEN PE GIRA LO HUSSAIN(AS)
KO.
english translation text:
Haider writhes, and the
Prophet is restless. How
can you repeatedly hear
these cries? A commotion
rises from the earth—come
and lift Hussain.

arabic text:
ACHE NAHI IRADAY YAZEEDI(L) SIPAH KE.
PAON NIKAL RAHE HAIN RAKABOON SE
SHAH(AS) KE.
GHAZI(AS) NAHI HAI TUM HI SANBHALO
HUSSAIN(AS) KO.
ZAINAB(SA) SADA YEH DETI HAI AYE BE-QARAR
MAA.
ZAKHMOON KO MILL KE BANDHEIN GI
HAIDER(AS) KI BETIYAAN.
KHAIMAY MEIN AIK BAR BULA LO HUSSAIN(AS)
KO.
english translation text:
The Yazidi army's intentions
are evil. The King's
feet are slipping from
the stirrups. Ghazi is
not here; you alone
must hold Hussain. Zainab
cries: O restless mother,
Haider's daughters will together
bind his wounds.
Call Hussain into the
tents just once.

arabic text:
RONE LAGI AYE:MIR TAKALLUM: WOH
GHAMZADAH.
PHAILA KE APNE HATH JO SHABIR(AS) NE KAHA.
GODI MEIN THORI DAIR SULA LO HUSSAIN(AS)
KO.
english translation text:
O Mir Taqallum, the grief-stricken
lady began to weep when Shabbir
spread out his hands and
said: let me sleep in your
lap for a little while.
